desc: Redraw this kingfisher as a detailed 16-bit indie game sprite: realistic kingfisher proportions, same face, blue back and wings, orange belly, long black beak, small plain eyes, same pose and silhouette. Muted natural palette, thin dark navy outline, 3-4 shade steps with pixel clusters, deeper shadows under head and belly, highlights on crest and wings, subtle feather shading. No gradients, no ground shadow.
